name: YouthLine Peer Crisis Volunteer
what_you_do: Volunteer with a crisis line for young people. Complete 65 or more hours of training and shadowing first.
who_can_apply: Ages 15 to 24. Volunteers age 15 to 17 must bring a parent or guardian to orientation. Sites are in Portland Metro, Warm Springs, Central Oregon and Maui, Hawaii.
pay_detail: Unpaid. The page mentions Work Study positions for young people who face money or other barriers.
duration: About 3.5 hours a week for at least one year
deadline_text: Orientations are held monthly. Dates are not listed on the program page.
how_to_apply: Sign up for a monthly orientation on the program page. You can also text YLVol to 85511 or email YLVolunteering@linesforlife.org. Next, you have an interview and training.
notes: The program page asks volunteers to commit to at least one year. Shifts are about 3.5 hours a week.
